shared_elements: horizontal band of repeated identical units (row of comb-like strokes / row of arch or loop motifs)
small isolated figures scattered on a monochrome ground
justification: The only real correspondence is the shared habit of setting small profile creatures and a few discs against an otherwise empty ground, with a horizontal register of repeated identical units running across the upper field in each (the comb-like crew strokes of A, the row of arch/loop motifs and hatched band of B). Everything else diverges: A is a flat, dark, two-dimensional silhouette drawing on a light, sloping rock surface dominated by long boat forms and stick-figure humans, while B is bulky three-dimensional relief carved into an upright block, dominated by naturalistically modelled quadrupeds and a bird, with no boats or human figures and no comparable ordering of the motifs.
